welcome_page.title: Your most frequent trip
welcome_page.description:
This questionnaire is about the trip you make most often and how you feel during it. It takes about 3 minutes.

Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your answers have been saved. Thank you for your time.

it.#SmartUrbanity - Your most frequent trip: SmartUrbanity - Il tuo spostamento più frequente
it.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Le tue risposte sono state salvate. Grazie per il tuo tempo.
it.#<p>Think about the trip you make most o: Pensa allo spostamento che fai più spesso in una settimana tipica.
it.#How do you usually make this trip?: Come fai di solito questo spostamento?
it.#Wheelchair or mobility scooter: Sedia a rotelle o scooter per disabili
it.#Shared bike or e-bike: Bici o bici elettrica in sharing
it.#Taxi or app-based car service (e.g. Ube: Taxi o auto con conducente tramite app (ad es. Uber, FreeNow)
it.#What is the main purpose of this trip?: Qual è lo scopo principale di questo spostamento?
it.#Less than once a month: Meno di una volta al mese
it.#Who do you usually make this trip with?: Con chi fai di solito questo spostamento? (Puoi sceglierne più di uno)
it.#How do you usually feel during this tri: Come ti senti di solito durante questo spostamento?
it.#Compared to what you expect, how long d: Rispetto a quanto ti aspetti, quanto dura di solito questo spostamento?
it.#A little shorter than expected: Un po' più breve del previsto
it.#A little longer than expected: Un po' più lungo del previsto
it.#How tired do you usually feel at the en: Quanto ti senti stanco/a di solito alla fine di questo spostamento?
it.#Physical effort (walking, cycling, carr: Lo sforzo fisico (camminare, pedalare, portare borse)
it.#Stress (traffic, time pressure, feeling: Lo stress (traffico, fretta, sentirsi in pericolo)
it.#How often do you feel anxious or overwh: Quanto spesso ti senti ansioso/a o sopraffatto/a durante questo spostamento?
it.#What makes you feel that way? (Up to 3): Cosa te lo fa provare? (Al massimo 3)
it.#Being in a hurry or late: La fretta o il rischio di fare tardi
it.#Fear of accidents or crime: La paura di incidenti o furti
it.#Health issues (pain, breathlessness, di: Problemi di salute (dolore, fiato corto, capogiri)
it.#Compared to other ways you could make t: Rispetto ad altri modi in cui potresti fare questo spostamento, quanto è faticoso quello che usi di solito?
it.#<p>This questionnaire is about the trip:
Questo questionario riguarda lo spostamento che fai più spesso e come ti senti mentre lo fai. Richiede circa 3 minuti.

La partecipazione è volontaria. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome: vengono salvate con un codice pseudonimo ricavato dal tuo indirizzo email, così che le risposte ai diversi questionari SmartUrbanity possano essere analizzate insieme.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

fr.#SmartUrbanity - Your most frequent trip: SmartUrbanity - Votre déplacement le plus fréquent
fr.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Vos réponses ont été enregistrées. Merci pour votre temps.
fr.#<p>Think about the trip you make most o: Pensez au déplacement que vous faites le plus souvent au cours d’une semaine type.
fr.#Wheelchair or mobility scooter: Fauteuil roulant ou scooter de mobilité
fr.#Shared bike or e-bike: Vélo ou vélo électrique en libre-service
fr.#Public transport (bus, tram, metro, tra: Transports en commun (bus, tram, métro, train)
fr.#Taxi or app-based car service (e.g. Ube: Taxi ou service de voiture via application (p. ex. Uber, FreeNow)
fr.#What is the main purpose of this trip?: Quel est le motif principal de ce déplacement ?
fr.#Leisure or visiting people: Loisirs ou visites à des proches
fr.#How often do you make this trip?: À quelle fréquence faites-vous ce déplacement ?
fr.#Who do you usually make this trip with?: Avec qui faites-vous habituellement ce déplacement ? (Plusieurs réponses possibles)
fr.#With family members: Avec des membres de ma famille
fr.#With friends or colleagues: Avec des amis/amies ou des collègues
fr.#How do you usually feel during this tri: Comment vous sentez-vous habituellement pendant ce déplacement ?
fr.#Compared to what you expect, how long d: Par rapport à ce que vous attendez, combien de temps dure habituellement ce déplacement ?
fr.#A little shorter than expected: Un peu moins longtemps que prévu
fr.#A little longer than expected: Un peu plus long que prévu
fr.#How tired do you usually feel at the en: À quel point vous sentez-vous généralement fatigué/fatiguée à la fin de ce trajet ?
fr.#What tires you the most?: Qu’est-ce qui vous fatigue le plus ?
fr.#Physical effort (walking, cycling, carr: L’effort physique (marcher, pédaler, porter des sacs)
fr.#Stress (traffic, time pressure, feeling: Le stress (circulation, pression du temps, sentiment d’insécurité)
fr.#Heat, noise or bad air: La chaleur, le bruit ou la mauvaise qualité de l’air
fr.#How often do you feel anxious or overwh: À quelle fréquence vous sentez-vous anxieux/anxieuse ou dépassé/dépassée pendant ce trajet ?
fr.#What makes you feel that way? (Up to 3): Qu’est-ce qui vous fait ressentir cela ? (Jusqu’à 3)
fr.#Fear of accidents or crime: Peur des accidents ou de la criminalité
fr.#Compared to other ways you could make t: Par rapport aux autres façons de faire ce trajet, à quel point votre façon habituelle est-elle fatigante ?
fr.#<p>This questionnaire is about the trip:
Ce questionnaire porte sur le trajet que vous faites le plus souvent et sur ce que vous ressentez pendant celui-ci. Il prend environ 3 minutes.

La participation est volontaire. Vos réponses ne sont pas liées à votre nom. Elles sont enregistrées sous un code pseudonyme dérivé de votre adresse e-mail, afin que vos réponses aux différents questionnaires SmartUrbanity puissent être analysées ensemble.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity

de.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Ihre Antworten wurden gespeichert. Vielen Dank für Ihre Zeit.
de.#<p>Think about the trip you make most o: Denken Sie an den Weg, den Sie in einer typischen Woche am häufigsten zurücklegen.
de.#How do you usually make this trip?: Wie legen Sie diesen Weg normalerweise zurück?
de.#Taxi or app-based car service (e.g. Ube: Taxi oder App-basierter Fahrdienst (z. B. Uber, FreeNow)
de.#What is the main purpose of this trip?: Was ist der Hauptzweck dieses Weges?
de.#How often do you make this trip?: Wie oft legen Sie diesen Weg zurück?
de.#Who do you usually make this trip with?: Mit wem legen Sie diesen Weg normalerweise zurück? (Mehrfachauswahl möglich)
de.#How do you usually feel during this tri: Wie fühlen Sie sich normalerweise während dieses Weges?
de.#Compared to what you expect, how long d: Verglichen mit Ihrer Erwartung: Wie lange dauert dieser Weg normalerweise?
de.#How tired do you usually feel at the en: Wie müde fühlen Sie sich normalerweise am Ende dieses Weges?
de.#How often do you feel anxious or overwh: Wie oft fühlen Sie sich während dieses Weges ängstlich oder überfordert?
de.#What makes you feel that way? (Up to 3): Was löst dieses Gefühl bei Ihnen aus? (Bis zu 3)
de.#Being in a hurry or late: In Eile oder zu spät sein
de.#Compared to other ways you could make t: Verglichen mit anderen Möglichkeiten, diesen Weg zurückzulegen: Wie anstrengend ist Ihre übliche Art?
de.#<p>This questionnaire is about the trip:
In diesem Fragebogen geht es um den Weg, den Sie am häufigsten zurücklegen, und darum, wie Sie sich dabei fühlen. Er dauert etwa 3 Minuten.

Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft. Sie werden unter einem pseudonymen Code gespeichert, der aus Ihrer E-Mail-Adresse abgeleitet wird, damit Ihre Antworten auf verschiedene SmartUrbanity-Fragebögen gemeinsam ausgewertet werden können.

Mehr über SmartUrbanity erfahren

tr.#<p>Think about the trip you make most o: Tipik bir haftada en sık yaptığınız yolculuğu düşünün.
tr.#Taxi or app-based car service (e.g. Ube: Taksi veya uygulama tabanlı araç hizmeti (örn. Uber, FreeNow)
tr.#Who do you usually make this trip with?: Bu yolculuğu genellikle kiminle yapıyorsunuz? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#How do you usually feel during this tri: Bu yolculuk sırasında genellikle nasıl hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#Compared to what you expect, how long d: Beklediğinize kıyasla bu yolculuk genellikle ne kadar sürüyor?
tr.#How tired do you usually feel at the en: Bu yolculuğun sonunda genellikle kendinizi ne kadar yorgun hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#Physical effort (walking, cycling, carr: Fiziksel çaba (yürümek, bisiklet sürmek, çanta taşımak)
tr.#Stress (traffic, time pressure, feeling: Stres (trafik, zaman baskısı, kendini güvende hissetmemek)
tr.#How often do you feel anxious or overwh: Bu yolculuk sırasında ne sıklıkla kaygılı veya bunalmış hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#What makes you feel that way? (Up to 3): Bunu hissetmenize ne neden oluyor? (En fazla 3)
tr.#Health issues (pain, breathlessness, di: Sağlık sorunları (ağrı, nefes darlığı, baş dönmesi)
tr.#Compared to other ways you could make t: Bu yolculuğu yapabileceğiniz diğer yollarla karşılaştırıldığında, her zamanki yolunuz ne kadar yorucu?
tr.#<p>This questionnaire is about the trip:
Bu anket, en sık yaptığınız yolculuk ve bu yolculuk sırasında nasıl hissettiğiniz hakkındadır. Yaklaşık 3 dakika sürer.

Katılım gönüllüdür. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez. Yanıtlarınız, e-posta adresinizden türetilen takma bir kod altında saklanır; böylece farklı SmartUrbanity anketlerine verdiğiniz yanıtlar birlikte analiz edilebilir.

SmartUrbanity hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinin

fa.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: پاسخ‌های شما ذخیره شد. از وقتی که گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#<p>Think about the trip you make most o: به سفری فکر کنید که در یک هفته معمولی بیش از همه انجام می‌دهید.
fa.#How do you usually make this trip?: معمولاً این سفر را چگونه انجام می‌دهید؟
fa.#Taxi or app-based car service (e.g. Ube: تاکسی یا سرویس خودرو با اپلیکیشن (مثلاً Uber، FreeNow)
fa.#How often do you make this trip?: هر چند وقت یک‌بار این سفر را انجام می‌دهید؟
fa.#Who do you usually make this trip with?: معمولاً این سفر را با چه کسی انجام می‌دهید؟ (همه موارد مناسب را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#How do you usually feel during this tri: معمولاً در طول این سفر چه حسی دارید؟
fa.#Compared to what you expect, how long d: در مقایسه با انتظارتان، این سفر معمولاً چقدر طول می‌کشد؟
fa.#How tired do you usually feel at the en: معمولاً در پایان این سفر چقدر احساس خستگی می‌کنید؟
fa.#What tires you the most?: چه چیزی بیش از همه شما را خسته می‌کند؟
fa.#Physical effort (walking, cycling, carr: تلاش بدنی (پیاده‌روی، دوچرخه‌سواری، حمل کیف و بار)
fa.#How often do you feel anxious or overwh: در طول این سفر چقدر احساس اضطراب یا درماندگی می‌کنید؟
fa.#What makes you feel that way? (Up to 3): چه چیزی باعث این احساس می‌شود؟ (حداکثر ۳ مورد)
fa.#Compared to other ways you could make t: در مقایسه با روش‌های دیگری که می‌توانستید این سفر را انجام دهید، روش معمول شما چقدر خسته‌کننده است؟
fa.#<p>This questionnaire is about the trip:
این پرسشنامه درباره سفری است که بیش از همه انجام می‌دهید و احساس شما در طول آن. تکمیل آن حدود ۳ دقیقه طول می‌کشد.

شرکت در آن داوطلبانه است. پاسخ‌های شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شود. پاسخ‌ها با یک کد مستعار که از نشانی ایمیل شما به‌دست می‌آید ذخیره می‌شوند تا پاسخ‌های شما به پرسشنامه‌های مختلف SmartUrbanity بتوانند با هم تحلیل شوند.

درباره SmartUrbanity بیشتر بدانید

hu.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Válaszait elmentettük. Köszönjük, hogy időt szánt ránk.
hu.#<p>Think about the trip you make most o: Gondoljon arra az útra, amelyet egy átlagos héten a leggyakrabban tesz meg.
hu.#How do you usually make this trip?: Hogyan teszi meg általában ezt az utat?
hu.#Taxi or app-based car service (e.g. Ube: Taxi vagy applikációs autós szolgáltatás (pl. Uber, FreeNow)
hu.#What is the main purpose of this trip?: Mi ennek az útnak a fő célja?
hu.#How often do you make this trip?: Milyen gyakran teszi meg ezt az utat?
hu.#Who do you usually make this trip with?: Kivel teszi meg általában ezt az utat? (Több válasz is megjelölhető)
hu.#How do you usually feel during this tri: Hogyan érzi magát általában ezen az úton?
hu.#Neither stressed nor relaxed: Se nem stresszes, se nem nyugodt
hu.#Compared to what you expect, how long d: Ahhoz képest, amire számít, mennyi ideig tart általában ez az út?
hu.#How tired do you usually feel at the en: Általában mennyire érzi magát fáradtnak ennek az útnak a végén?
hu.#Stress (traffic, time pressure, feeling: Stressz (forgalom, időnyomás, a biztonság hiányának érzése)
hu.#How often do you feel anxious or overwh: Milyen gyakran érzi magát szorongónak vagy túlterheltnek ezen az úton?
hu.#What makes you feel that way? (Up to 3): Mi váltja ki ezt az érzést? (Legfeljebb 3)
hu.#Fear of accidents or crime: Félelem a balesetektől vagy a bűnözéstől
hu.#Compared to other ways you could make t: Más lehetőségekhez képest, ahogyan ezt az utat megtehetné, mennyire fárasztó a szokásos módja?
hu.#<p>This questionnaire is about the trip:
Ez a kérdőív arról az útról szól, amelyet a leggyakrabban tesz meg, és arról, hogyan érzi magát közben. Kitöltése körülbelül 3 percet vesz igénybe.

A részvétel önkéntes. Válaszait nem kapcsoljuk össze a nevével. Azokat az e-mail-címéből képzett álnevesített kód alatt tároljuk, hogy a különböző SmartUrbanity-kérdőívekre adott válaszait együtt lehessen elemezni.

Tudjon meg többet a SmartUrbanityről

ar.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: تم حفظ إجاباتك. شكرًا لك على وقتك.
ar.#<p>Think about the trip you make most o: فكِّر في التنقل الذي تقوم به أكثر من غيره في أسبوع عادي.
ar.#Taxi or app-based car service (e.g. Ube: تاكسي أو خدمة سيارات عبر تطبيق (مثل Uber وFreeNow)
ar.#What is the main purpose of this trip?: ما الغرض الرئيسي من هذا التنقل؟
ar.#Who do you usually make this trip with?: مع من تقوم بهذا التنقل عادةً؟ (اختر كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#How do you usually feel during this tri: كيف تشعر عادةً أثناء هذا التنقل؟
ar.#Compared to what you expect, how long d: مقارنةً بما تتوقعه، كم يستغرق هذا التنقل عادةً؟
ar.#How tired do you usually feel at the en: ما مدى شعورك بالتعب عادةً في نهاية هذه الرحلة؟
ar.#Physical effort (walking, cycling, carr: الجهد البدني (المشي، ركوب الدراجة، حمل الحقائب)
ar.#Stress (traffic, time pressure, feeling: التوتر (حركة المرور، ضيق الوقت، الشعور بعدم الأمان)
ar.#Heat, noise or bad air: الحرارة أو الضوضاء أو الهواء الرديء
ar.#How often do you feel anxious or overwh: كم مرة تشعر بالقلق أو الإرهاق النفسي خلال هذه الرحلة؟
ar.#Compared to other ways you could make t: مقارنةً بالطرق الأخرى التي يمكنك بها القيام بهذه الرحلة، ما مدى إرهاق طريقتك المعتادة؟
ar.#<p>This questionnaire is about the trip:
يتناول هذا الاستبيان الرحلة التي تقوم بها في أغلب الأحيان وشعورك خلالها. يستغرق نحو 3 دقائق.

المشاركة طوعية. لا تُربط إجاباتك باسمك، بل تُحفظ تحت رمز مستعار مشتق من عنوان بريدك الإلكتروني، بحيث يمكن تحليل إجاباتك على استبيانات SmartUrbanity المختلفة معًا.
